tool.description: Combine several images into a single collage PNG. layout is grid (default), horizontal (one row), or vertical (one column); columns sets the grid width; gap adds pixel spacing; background sets the fill color (#rrggbb). Each image is scaled to fit a uniform cell with its aspect ratio preserved. Provide images as a list, each a url or a `ref` (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/BMP).

images.description: Ordered list of image sources (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/BMP). Each item has exactly one of `url` or `ref`.

url.description: URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

layout.description: Arrangement: grid (default), horizontal (one row), or vertical (one column).

columns.description: Number of columns for grid layout (default: roughly square). Ignored for horizontal/vertical.

gap.description: Gap/padding in pixels between and around cells (default 0).

background.description: Background color as #rgb, #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa (default white). Shows in gaps and letterbox areas.
